source_row.wylie: tshig rtsub po ni bsams bzhin du ma nor bar mi snyan pa'i tshig gi don pha rol pos go ba'o
source_row.english: Harsh speech consists of unpleasant words which are spoken purposely, and without any mistake; their meaning too should be understood by the other person.

spans.rationale: Established harsh-speech compound; the following two members are unique and strictly tighter than this title.
Speech member is inside the title, not the later independent words noun.
Harsh member belongs to the title and excludes the speech component.
The intentionally/purposely compound qualifies this harsh utterance. It does not include and or without.
The negative particle owns without in the nonmistaken-utterance condition; exclude any.
Error noun is the singular mistake; do not import353 mistaken identity or a wealth sense of NOR.
Whole negative evaluative compound is unpleasant. No English un affix is extracted, because the proposed whole compound already makes the correct lexical claim.
This independent noun is words in the definition, distinct from TSHIG inside the earlier title.
The word-content noun owns meaning. Too is a supplied connective, not part of the meaning noun.
Whole agentive-inflected recipient expression owns other person, excluding by/the and preserving the source S.
The understanding verb owns understood. Its passive/necessity framing remains unwrapped.
